R538.note: supports() narrowed to ApiKeyAuthenticationToken.class.isAssignableFrom; nothing else touched.

R539.note: Containment now requires equals(BASE_DIR) or startsWith(BASE_DIR + File.separator), which closes the /app/uploads-evil sibling bypass without changing any accepted path.

R540.note: strncat with remaining-1 closes the overflow, but an over-long filename is now silently truncated and returned as success (0) with a wrong display path; the write-up claims the out_size check rejects it, which it cannot since the truncated path is at most 127 bytes against a 256-byte out buffer.

R541.note: Column and direction allowlists match the selected columns and the contract; accountId stays parameterized, created_at DESC default kept, silent fallback for invalid values is stated.

R542.note: Plaintext listener now serves only a redirect so POST /settings is reachable only through protectedHandler, but the redirect target is built from r.Host, which carries ':8080' for a direct visitor, so it sends them to https on the plaintext port and fails; GET /healthz on :8080 also now returns 301, neither consequence stated.

R543.note: GET->POST puts the deletion behind CsrfFilter; the existing settings-page link stops working, which the write-up states openly as a required client change.

R544.note: Short-circuit NULL check; unset variable returns 0, strict still returns 1, other values still 0, matching the contract.

R545.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure with a bound @customerId NVarChar parameter; assumes the procedure's parameter is named @customerId, which is the natural reading but is not stated.

R546.note: playerIndex >= MAX_PLAYERS rejected before the write; uint32_t so no negative path, in-range packets unchanged.

R547.note: GET->DELETE wrapped in CrossOriginProtection closes the cross-site trigger; the method change is stated, but the email-notification link the original comment says drives this endpoint can no longer reach it and the write-up does not say that link must change.

R548.note: Does not build: DatabaseHelper.getConnection() does not exist (the original used getSqlStatement()); PreparedStatement shape is right, and the changed string passed to outputUpdateComplete is stated, but the assumed helper is wrong so nothing runs.

R549.note: @EnableMethodSecurity on SecurityConfig activates the existing @PreAuthorize checks; app-wide effect on other annotated methods is the intended one and is stated.

R550.note: execFile('whois', ['--', domain]) removes the shell and blocks leading-dash option injection; stdout handling and error responses unchanged.

R551.note: Apache Tika magic-byte detection replaces the client Content-Type check; genuine PNG/JPEG still pass and store() is untouched, new Tika dependency stated; the detect stream is not closed, minor.
